correctness.rationale: Direct proof: Poisson-reorientation embedded clipped random walk has a unique symmetric stationary law; boundary atoms control sup|CDF−1/2| by H(s). Renewal-reward mechanics give P(s)=m+−s/4+∫ C(x)H(s−x)dx, hence a controlled second-order integral. Singular Laplace asymptotics give each coefficient and error order; d=1 closed form and d=2,3 formulas checked by 98 reproducible numerical assertions from checker.py. The stated quantifiers, force normalization and non-applicable slowly varying cases are explicit.

This is originality of a mathematical consequence of a known model, not novelty of the model or its renewal kernel; unindexed coverage remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: Complete natural small-slit response classification for one physical observable, across a family of heading laws. It distinguishes a fractional-power force response for grazing-singular orientation distributions from a logarithmic response when grazing density is finite and positive, and a regular quadratic response when inverse-speed moment is finite. The coefficient directly recovers an orientational quantity from force measurements; explicit d=2,3 constants provide benchmarks beyond the leading narrow-gap force. Error control avoids needing a full singular stationary density.
